text:
Oliver (product): quick design review — private setup wizard networking step. I pushed a new mock to /figma but main ask: can we make the prereq checklist more compact and less intimidating for infra-averse users? also need screenreader flow checked.

Maya (design): saw the mock, thanks. thinking: collapse optional advanced checks under an accordion, show a short friendly line for each prereq instead of full bullets. e.g., 'SSH access to seed host (recommended) — we use this to verify connectivity'.

Raj (frontend): collapsing is fine, but watch keyboard focus when accordion opens. if we auto-expand on validation error, focus should jump to first failing field.

Ada (a11y): yes — focus management is critical. also ensure the prereq status pills have ARIA live updates. screenreader should hear "SSH check failed" not just a color change.

Sam (pm): user story: many customers assumed network checks would modify their firewall. we should add copy that explicitly says "we only run lightweight probes from your browser/agent; no inbound firewall changes are made." short and bolded.

Maya (design): good call. proposed copy for the top helper: "We’ll run non-invasive checks to confirm your environment meets the minimum networking requirements. Nothing will be changed on your firewall."

Raj (frontend): small nit — the mock uses a 3-column layout for rule details. on small screens that becomes a long horizontal table. suggest stacked rows at <960px.

Ada (a11y): also provide an accessible summary for the whole step that can be toggled open. includes: what we check, why, and how long it takes. screen readers shouldn't be forced to read every single rule.

Oliver (product): decision proposal: 1) collapse advanced checks in accordion, 2) concise helper copy (Maya's text), 3) ARIA live for status pills and clear focus jump on error, 4) responsive stacking for rule list. yay/nay?

Maya (design): yay. I'll update the figma and include an a11y demo page.

Raj (frontend): yay. I'll prototype focus behavior and responsive stack. might need a small util for trap/focus return after accordion close.

Ada (a11y): yay. I'll write the SR reads and example testing checklist for QA. recommend also testing VoiceOver + NVDA with long rule lists.

Sam (pm): yay. I'll add this to the sprint and flag as high-priority for Private onboarding flow.
